protocol.name: reprise_output_trial_v1
protocol.copyright: reprise private protocol: a display change held on trial by the compositor.

interface.name: reprise_output_trial_manager_v1
interface.description: One global, offered to the clients that get zwlr_output_manager_v1. A client begins a trial before it applies a configuration through wlr-output-management and covers that configuration with it; until the trial is kept, the compositor puts the outputs back as they ran when it began.

request.name: begin
request.description: The compositor notes every output's state now: on or off, mode, position, scale, transform and adaptive sync. The trial is answered at once: started when it is held, or ended with busy when another trial is held, which it leaves alone. One trial is held at a time, by any client. It is held for seconds, counted from begin; 0 counts as 1 and anything over 60 as 60.

arg.name: seconds
arg.summary: how long it is held before it is put back

interface.name: reprise_output_trial_v1
interface.description: While held, every configuration applied, by any client, stays unsaved. The trial ends with the outputs put back when its seconds run out, on revert, or when the object is destroyed or its client goes before keep. A put back skips an output that is gone, waits while the session is off its seat and for modes to settle, and is tried once more when it fails. An apply that was still waiting when outputs were put back, or made while a put back waits, is cancelled.

entry.name: invalid_configuration
entry.summary: the configuration was applied, tested or covered already

entry.name: failed
entry.summary: the outputs could not be put back

entry.name: busy
entry.summary: another trial is held; nothing was noted

request.name: destroy
request.description: A trial still held ends as on revert, and no ended is sent.

request.name: keep
request.description: Ends the trial with kept; the compositor saves what runs as it saves an apply. Ignored once ended.

request.name: revert
request.description: Ends the trial with reverted or failed once the outputs are put back. Ignored once ended.

request.name: cover

description.summary: tie a configuration to the trial

request.description: Names a configuration of this client's, before its apply or test. The compositor applies a covered configuration only while this trial is held: once the trial has ended, or when it was refused busy, the apply is answered cancelled and changes nothing, so a configuration meant for the trial never lands outside it. Allowed after ended, with that effect. Covering a configuration applied, tested or covered already is the invalid_configuration error.

event.name: started
event.description: Sent at once after begin. The client applies its configuration, covered, only after this, so a refused trial leaves nothing applied.

event.name: ended
event.description: Sent once. Afterwards the object does nothing and should be destroyed.
